column1: # docs/manifest.tsv — products this repo uses and where to vendor their docs.
# One row per product, pipe-delimited. Whitespace around fields is ignored;
# blank lines and lines starting with '#' are comments.
#   name      short id; becomes docs/vendor/<name>.md  (chars: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -)
#               llms-txt  curl an upstream llms.txt / llms-full.txt bundle
#               git-raw   curl a raw file from GitHub (works behind GitHub-only egress)
#               go-doc    run `go doc -all <import-path>`, pinned to go.mod's version
#               none      reference-only; listed in the index, nothing fetched
#   source    the URL to curl (llms-txt/git-raw), or the Go import path (go-doc),
#   reference canonical human docs URL (for the index)
# Refresh with `make docs`. Run it where outbound network is open: in this repo's
# sandbox only GitHub egress is allowed, so llms-txt rows will MISS here and must
# be refreshed locally or in CI.
# --- Frontend stack (web/) — llms.txt bundles, fetched where egress is open ---
# --- Tooling — GitHub-hosted, reachable from the sandbox ---
# --- Go libraries — snapshotted from the version pinned in go.mod via `go doc` ---
# These MISS until a root go.mod exists and the dependency is added.
